title: ERIS: Enhancing the Privacy-Utility-Scalability Trade-Off in Federated Learning via Federated Shard Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2602.08617v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scaling Federated Learning (FL) to billion-parameter models forces a challenging trade-off between privacy, scalability, and model utility. Existing solutions often tackle these challenges in isolation, sacrificing accuracy, relying on costly cryptographic tools, or introducing communication and optimization inefficiencies that affect convergence. We introduce ERIS, an FL framework centered on Federated Shard Aggregation (FSA), a novel mechanism that partitions each client update into non-overlapping shards whose aggregation is distributed across multiple client-side aggregators. FSA removes the central aggregation bottleneck, limits the information visible to any single observer, and preserves the centralized FL update after reassembly. translated_title: ERIS：通过联邦分片聚合增强联邦学习中的隐私-效用-可扩展性权衡
translated_abstract: 将联邦学习（FL）扩展到十亿参数级别的模型，会在隐私、可扩展性和模型效用之间带来一个具有挑战性的权衡。现有解决方案往往孤立地应对这些挑战，要么牺牲精度，要么依赖昂贵的密码学工具，要么引入影响收敛的通信和优化低效问题。我们提出了ERIS，一个以联邦分片聚合（FSA）为核心的联邦学习框架。FSA是一种新颖的机制，它将每个客户端的更新分割成互不重叠的分片，并将这些分片的聚合任务分散到多个客户端聚合器上执行。FSA消除了中央聚合瓶颈，限制了任何单一观察者可见的信息，并在重新组装后保持与集中式联邦学习更新的一致性。此外，ERIS可以便捷地集成分布式移位压缩（DSC），以减少传输负载和暴露的坐标数量。我们证明了在标准假设下，ERIS能够保持收敛性……
tldr: ERIS提出联邦分片聚合（FSA）机制，将客户端更新分割为互不重叠的分片并分散至多个客户端聚合器进行聚合，从而在十亿参数规模的联邦学习中同时改善隐私、可扩展性与模型效用之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: ERIS introduces Federated Shard Aggregation (FSA), which partitions client updates into non-overlapping shards aggregated by multiple client-side aggregators, thereby simultaneously improving the privacy-utility-scalability trade-off of federated learning for billion-parameter models.
